articles.title: Keith Vasquez, 66, Volunteer Firefighter
articles.deck: Friends remember Keith Vasquez for the many years of service to Marsh Landing.
body: Born in Marsh Landing in the years after the war, Keith Vasquez spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.
Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Marsh Landing.

Keith Vasquez died in February at home on Meadow Court, at the age of 66. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Lower Millrace Improvement Group in his or her name.

articles.title: Millrace Middle School Board Approves Summer Concert Series
articles.deck: The program begins in August and is open to all students in grade 8 and up.
body: Students will meet on Friday afternoons in the Kettle Hill Park gate, and transportation will be provided for those who need it.
Principal Dolores Zielinski said the program was built with help from parents and local volunteers. Sign-up forms went home in backpacks this week, and the first session is set for August.
